raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Document the startup requirements for hybrid SSM/Mamba disaggregated serving:
NIXL's DS convolution-state layout and the connector's HMA capability.
Closes #54387.

## Claims

- The NIXL usage guide shows `export VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS` and makes
  clear that both prefill and decode instances need the setting.
- The general guide explains `SupportsHMA`, the requirement for every
  `MultiConnector` child, and the default behavior for unsupported connectors.
- The compatibility matrix links directly to the setup instructions.

## Validation

Checked each statement against the current layout selector, NIXL worker
assertion, HMA configuration policy, connector factory, and connector classes.
An independent review also checked the source claims and documentation links.

```bash
pre-commit run --files docs/features/disagg_prefill.md docs/features/nixl_connector_usage.md docs/features/nixl_connector_compatibility.md
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu VLLM_PLUGINS='' API_AUTONAV_EXCLUDE='re:^vllm\.(?!distributed(?:\.|$)).*' .venv/bin/python -m mkdocs build
```

Applicable pre-commit hooks and the MkDocs build pass. API generation was
limited to the distributed modules; unrelated omitted-reference warnings
remain, with no warnings for the three edited pages. The rendered sections
were inspected and all 11 checked section/API links resolve.
This changes documentation only; no runtime behavior, model output, or
performance change is claimed, so GPU tests and model evaluations do not apply.

## Details

The existing compatibility matrix reports hybrid support, but the usage guide
does not expose the layout required by the NIXL worker's startup assertion.
Add the setting to the prerequisites and cross-link it from the overview and
matrix so it can be found before launching the servers.

This follows up on closed, unmerged #54489. It incorporates the review's request
for exported shell syntax and a capability rule with examples rather than an
exhaustive connector list that can go stale. The issue timeline and open-PR
searches found no active replacement. Developed with AI assistance.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Three existing docs pages; no runtime changes.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Source, lint and rendered-link checks pass; the human submitter reviewed and approved the patch and validation report.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Source-backed guidance with shared setup instructions.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes issue, prior review context and validation scope.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -49,6 +49,21 @@ Now supports 9 types of connectors:
   --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"FlexKVConnectorV1","kv_role":"kv_both"}'
   ```
 
+## Hybrid models
+
+Hybrid SSM/Mamba models require the
+[hybrid KV cache manager](../design/hybrid_kv_cache_manager.md) (HMA).
+Choose a connector that implements the `SupportsHMA` capability, such as
+`NixlConnector` or `MooncakeConnector`. With `MultiConnector`, **every configured
+child connector** must support HMA.
+
+By default, vLLM disables HMA when the connector configuration does not support
+it. Hybrid SSM models then fail at startup; sliding-window attention models
+can run with reduced performance. Declaring HMA support does not establish
+support for every model or transfer configuration, so check the selected
+connector's documentation. For NixlConnector, also follow the
+[hybrid SSM/Mamba setup requirements](nixl_connector_usage.md#hybrid-ssmmamba-models).
+
 ## Reusing prefill token ids on decode
 
 !!! note

@@ -73,6 +73,10 @@ what may differ.
 
 ## Configuration Notes
 
+For hybrid SSM/Mamba models, follow the
+[hybrid-model setup requirements](nixl_connector_usage.md#hybrid-ssmmamba-models),
+including `VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS` on both P and D.
+
 ### What must match between P and D
 
 By default, a **compatibility hash** is checked during handshake. P and D instances must agree on:

@@ -21,6 +21,22 @@ For non-cuda platform, please install nixl with ucx build from source, instructe
 python tools/install_nixl_from_source_ubuntu.py
 ```
 
+### Hybrid SSM/Mamba models
+
+For hybrid SSM/Mamba models (including GDN), set the convolution-state layout
+to `DS` in the environment of **both the prefiller and decoder** before
+starting either instance:
+
+```bash
+export VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS
+```
+
+NixlConnector requires this layout for convolution-state transfer. Using `SD`
+instead triggers a startup assertion. These models also require the hybrid
+KV cache manager (HMA); do not disable it. See the
+[hybrid-model connector requirements](disagg_prefill.md#hybrid-models) and
+the [compatibility matrix](nixl_connector_compatibility.md) for other constraints.
+
